create_udop_config: create a UdopConfig instance with custom model parameters like d_model, num_layers, and feed_forward_proj
initialize_udop_config_from_pretrained: initialize a UdopConfig from a pretrained checkpoint such as microsoft/udop-large
validate_udop_config: validate the UdopConfig architecture by checking feed_forward_proj format and other constraints
configure_udop_relative_bias: configure UdopConfig with custom relative_bias_args for 1d, horizontal, and vertical attention buckets
inspect_udop_config_attributes: inspect UdopConfig attribute mappings for hidden_size, num_attention_heads, and num_hidden_layers
